## About
Fat Wallet Customs covers just about every part of the custom paint and restoration process under one roof in Portland. The only things we send out are interiors and drivetrain components, so you can bring a car in and drive it out turn key after a full restoration.
Owner Lucas Hamlin got hooked on classic and custom cars when he bought his first car, an Edsel Corsair. He took body and paint classes right out of high school, apprenticed under Dave Bradley and Gary Crisp, and then branched out on his own to start Fat Wallet Customs.
Big job or small one, from a chopped top to high end collision repair, give us a call and tell us what you need done on your project.

## Services
- Custom paint and airbrush: Custom colors, flames, artwork, airbrushing and finish work.
- Full restorations: Classic car restorations handled in house, except interiors and drivetrain, so you can pick the car up ready to drive.
- Rust repair and panel replacement: Rust repair, collision damage and panel replacement, fixed right.
- Body mods: Chopped tops, suicide doors, shaved trim and whatever else you have in mind.
- Collision repair: High end collision repair work alongside our custom and restoration jobs.

## FAQ
Q: Is there anything you don't do in house?
A: The only things we farm out are interiors and drivetrain components. Everything else in the paint and restoration process happens at our shop.

Q: Will you take a small job?
A: Yes. No job is too big and no job is too small. Reach out and ask about anything you need done.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I send a message?
A: If a reply is needed, you will hear back within 48-72 hours.
